cds.title: Texas Tech University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF, version dated 10-2-26)

scorecard.title: College Scorecard (location, enrollment, cost; data released 2026-10-15)

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs from the Common Data Set G1 (the '2026-27 costs not available' box is not ticked): in-district tuition $9,044, out-of-state and nonresident tuition $21,884.40, required fees $2,975.16, on-campus food and housing $12,000 (housing $7,500 + meal plan $4,500). The in-state (out-of-district) row of G1 also reads $21,884.40, the same as the non-resident row, and these split figures do not match Texas Tech's published 2026-27 tuition-and-fees totals (resident $11,852, non-resident $24,451), so the cycle file's cost block (published figures) replaces them. Per-credit-hour: in-district $301.48, out-of-state and nonresident $729.48. Estimated expenses: books $1,200, transportation $2,731, other $2,000 (other costs shown = transportation + other). The CDS says institutional need-based and non-need-based aid is available to nonresidents; 568 degree-seeking nonresidents received it (average $7,568).

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2025 entering class): 38,566 applied, 26,634 admitted, 7,579 enrolled. The residency rows (in-state / out-of-state / international / unknown) add up to the totals; 29 applicants and 22 admits have unknown residency and are in the totals only. International first-years: 1,582 applied, 574 admitted, 126 enrolled. The GPA breakdown is the 'all enrolled students' column of C11 (C12 average 3.64). CDS C21 says no early decision plan; the early action question (C22) is not answered and the waitlist section is blank. Undergraduate enrollment (34,021) and the nonresident count (830) are the 'Total Undergraduates' figures from B1/B2. A draft of this CDS (dated 4-30-26) is also on the university site; the admissions and test-score numbers are identical, the final version adds the cost and aid sections.
